title: AARO's MFR marks Borland's triangle sighting unclassified and moves the rest into a SAP

tellings.quote: >> Because they wrote my memorandum for record. It's called an MFR. and what my triangle sighting was listed as unclassified.
Because Arrow proved it when they listed it as unclassified and then classified the other drawings dealing with unidentified unknown origin drawings and technologies.
tellings.difference: Names Langley and gives no date or MFR detail; it presents the classification as proof.
tellings.link_reason: Both say AARO listed Borland's Langley triangle sighting as unclassified and classified his other drawings.

as_told.title: AARO left the Langley triangle sighting unclassified

plain: A former Air Force serviceman named Dylan Borland says that in 2023 AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into UFO reports, wrote up his account in a memorandum for record, or MFR, an official written note of a meeting, and listed his sighting of a triangle-shaped craft as unclassified. He tells Michels first-hand that the office then classified his other drawings of technologies of "unknown origin," moving them into a SAP, a tightly restricted secret programme, and he takes that as proof the technologies are real; in one telling he also mentions Langley.
